```text
import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { isBoundToContainer } from "./typeChecks";

import type { ElementsMap, ExcalidrawElement } from "./types";

/** `customData` key holding the id of the client that created the element */
export const CREATOR_ID_KEY = "creatorId";

/** bucket for elements without (valid) creator metadata, e.g. legacy rooms */
export const UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID = "__unknown__";

const getStampedCreatorId = (element: ExcalidrawElement): string | null => {
  const creatorId = element.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY];
  return typeof creatorId === "string" && creatorId ? creatorId : null;
};

/**
 * Returns the id of the client that created the element, or
 * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` if it isn't known.
 *
 * Bound text follows its container so labels never show/hide separately
 * from the shape they belong to.
 */
export const getElementCreatorId = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
): string => {
  const owner = isBoundToContainer(element)
    ? elementsMap.get(element.containerId) ?? element
    : element;

  return getStampedCreatorId(owner) ?? UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID;
};

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CreatorVisibility = {
  /**
   * creator ids hidden on this client. `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` hides the
   * miscellaneous bucket.
   */
  hiddenCollaboratorIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  /**
   * creators this client can name (seen at some point). Stamped creators
   * missing from it are treated as unknown (miscellaneous). `null`/omitted
   * (e.g. outside of a room) → every stamped creator is its own bucket.
   */
  collaboratorDirectory?: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown> | null;
};

/**
 * The visibility bucket an element belongs to: its creator, or
 * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` for untagged elements and creators this client has
 * never seen.
 */
export const getElementVisibilityBucket = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  collaboratorDirectory: CreatorVisibility["collaboratorDirectory"],
): string => {
  const creatorId = getElementCreatorId(element, elementsMap);
  if (
    collaboratorDirectory &&
    creatorId !== UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID &&
    !collaboratorDirectory.has(creatorId)
  ) {
    return UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID;
  }
  return creatorId;
};

/**
 * Whether the element's visibility bucket is hidden.
 *
 * Element-level counterpart of the editor's `isElementHiddenLocally`, so
 * element logic (selection, binding) can exclude hidden collaborators'
 * elements without depending on the editor package.
 */
export const isElementByHiddenCreator = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds, collaboratorDirectory }: CreatorVisibility,
): boolean => {
  if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size) {
    return false;
  }
  return hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(
    getElementVisibilityBucket(element, elementsMap, collaboratorDirectory),
  );
};

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CreatorInteractivity = CreatorVisibility & {
  /**
   * creator ids locked on this client (visible but non-interactive).
   * `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` locks the miscellaneous bucket.
   */
  lockedCollaboratorIds?: ReadonlySet<string>;
};

/**
 * The interactivity rule (#81): whether this client may interact with a
 * visibility bucket's elements.
 *
 * - hidden → never interactive (no interactivity without visibility)
 * - your own bucket → can't be locked
 * - otherwise → interactive unless locked
 */
export const isCollaboratorInteractive = (
  bucketId: string,
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds, lockedCollaboratorIds }: CreatorInteractivity,
  selfId: string | null,
): boolean => {
  if (hiddenCollaboratorIds?.has(bucketId)) {
    return false;
  }
  if (bucketId === selfId) {
    return true;
  }
  return !lockedCollaboratorIds?.has(bucketId);
};

/** returns the lock list with `ids` added, never including yourself */
export const addLockedCollaborators = (
  lockedCollaboratorIds: ReadonlySet<string> | undefined,
  ids: Iterable<string>,
  selfId: string | null,
): Set<string> => {
  const next = new Set(lockedCollaboratorIds);
  for (const id of ids) {
    if (id !== selfId) {
      next.add(id);
    }
  }
  return next;
};

/**
 * Returns the lock list with `bucketId` toggled. Ignored for hidden buckets
 * (their lock can't change while hidden) and for yourself.
 */
export const toggleLockedCollaborator = (
  state: CreatorInteractivity,
  bucketId: string,
  selfId: string | null,
): Set<string> => {
  const next = new Set(state.lockedCollaboratorIds);
  if (bucketId === selfId || state.hiddenCollaboratorIds?.has(bucketId)) {
    return next;
  }
  if (!next.delete(bucketId)) {
    next.add(bucketId);
  }
  return next;
};

/**
 * Returns the lock list after "unlock all": every visible bucket is
 * unlocked, hidden ones stay locked (so they're still locked once shown).
 */
export const unlockVisibleCollaborators = (
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds }: CreatorInteractivity,
  selfId: string | null,
): Set<string> =>
  addLockedCollaborators(undefined, hiddenCollaboratorIds ?? [], selfId);

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CreatorSelf = {
  collaborators?: ReadonlyMap<
    unknown,
    Readonly<{ id?: string; isCurrentUser?: boolean }>
  >;
};

/** this client's creator id (the current user's collaborator entry), if any */
export const getSelfCreatorId = ({
  collaborators,
}: CreatorSelf): string | null => {
  for (const collaborator of collaborators?.values() ?? []) {
    if (collaborator.isCurrentUser && collaborator.id) {
      return collaborator.id;
    }
  }
  return null;
};

/**
 * Whether this client may interact with the element (select, move, resize,
 * rotate, delete, erase, text-edit). Applies `isCollaboratorInteractive` to
 * the element's visibility bucket, so hidden elements are never interactive.
 *
 * @param selfId defaults to the current user's id from `state.collaborators`;
 * pass it when checking many elements.
 */
export const isElementInteractive = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  state: CreatorInteractivity & CreatorSelf,
  selfId: string | null = getSelfCreatorId(state),
): boolean =>
  isCollaboratorInteractive(
    getElementVisibilityBucket(
      element,
      elementsMap,
      state.collaboratorDirectory,
    ),
    state,
    selfId,
  );

/**
 * Filters out elements this client may not interact with (hidden or locked
 * collaborators'). Returns the input array as-is when nobody is hidden or
 * locked.
 *
 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to a map
 * of `elements`, so pass the full scene map when `elements` is a subset.
 */
export const excludeNonInteractiveElements = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  state: CreatorInteractivity & CreatorSelf,
  elementsMap?: ElementsMap,
): readonly T[] => {
  if (
    !state.hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size &&
    !state.lockedCollaboratorIds?.size
  ) {
    return elements;
  }
  const map = elementsMap ?? arrayToMap(elements);
  const selfId = getSelfCreatorId(state);
  return elements.filter((element) =>
    isElementInteractive(element, map, state, selfId),
  );
};

/**
 * Filters out elements whose visibility bucket is hidden. Returns the input
 * array as-is when nothing is hidden.
 *
 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to a map
 * of `elements`, so pass the full scene map when `elements` is a subset.
 */
export const excludeElementsByHiddenCreators = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  visibility: CreatorVisibility,
  elementsMap?: ElementsMap,
): readonly T[] => {
  if (!visibility.hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size) {
    return elements;
  }
  const map = elementsMap ?? arrayToMap(elements);
  return elements.filter(
    (element) => !isElementByHiddenCreator(element, map, visibility),
  );
};

import {
  CaptureUpdateAction,
  addLockedCollaborators,
  toggleLockedCollaborator,
  unlockVisibleCollaborators,
} from "@excalidraw/element";

import {
  eyeClosedIcon,
  eyeIcon,
  LockedIcon,
  UnlockedIcon,
} from "../components/icons";
import {
  getSelfCollaboratorId,
  getVisibilityBuckets,
} from "../scene/visibility";

import { register } from "./register";

/*
 * Local-only visibility of collaborators' drawings. These only change
 * `appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds` (never synced, never in history); hiding
 * your own drawings locks view mode (enforced in App.componentDidUpdate).
 *
 * Hiding a collaborator also locks them (#81), so they stay non-interactive
 * once shown again, until unlocked.
 */

/** toggles one visibility bucket (a creator id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
export const actionToggleCollaboratorVisibility = register<string>({
  name: "toggleCollaboratorVisibility",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.toggle",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  // must work in view mode: it's how you get out of the self-hide lock
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState, bucketId) {
    if (!bucketId) {
      return false;
    }
    const hiddenCollaboratorIds = new Set(appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds);
    let { lockedCollaboratorIds } = appState;
    if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds.delete(bucketId)) {
      hiddenCollaboratorIds.add(bucketId);
      lockedCollaboratorIds = addLockedCollaborators(
        lockedCollaboratorIds,
        [bucketId],
        getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
      );
    }
    return {
      appState: { ...appState, hiddenCollaboratorIds, lockedCollaboratorIds },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

export const actionShowAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "showAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.showAll",
  icon: eyeIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: { ...appState, hiddenCollaboratorIds: new Set() },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
  predicate: (elements, appState) => appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size > 0,
});

/** hides everyone, including yourself (which locks view mode) */
export const actionHideAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "hideAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorVisibility.hideAll",
  icon: eyeClosedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    const hiddenCollaboratorIds = getVisibilityBuckets(elements, appState);
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        hiddenCollaboratorIds,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: addLockedCollaborators(
          appState.lockedCollaboratorIds,
          hiddenCollaboratorIds,
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

/*
 * Local-only locking (#81): locked collaborators' drawings stay visible but
 * are non-interactive. These only change `appState.lockedCollaboratorIds`
 * (never synced, never in history). The rules live in `element/ownership.ts`.
 */

/** toggles one bucket's lock (ignored while hidden, and for yourself) */
export const actionToggleCollaboratorLock = register<string>({
  name: "toggleCollaboratorLock",
  label: "collaboratorLock.toggle",
  icon: LockedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState, bucketId) {
    if (!bucketId) {
      return false;
    }
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: toggleLockedCollaborator(
          appState,
          bucketId,
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

/** locks every listed bucket except yourself */
export const actionLockAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "lockAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorLock.lockAll",
  icon: LockedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: addLockedCollaborators(
          appState.lockedCollaboratorIds,
          getVisibilityBuckets(elements, appState),
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

/** unlocks every visible bucket; hidden ones stay locked */
export const actionUnlockAllCollaborators = register({
  name: "unlockAllCollaborators",
  label: "collaboratorLock.unlockAll",
  icon: UnlockedIcon,
  viewMode: true,
  trackEvent: { category: "collab" },
  perform(elements, appState) {
    return {
      appState: {
        ...appState,
        lockedCollaboratorIds: unlockVisibleCollaborators(
          appState,
          getSelfCollaboratorId(appState),
        ),
      },
      captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER,
    };
  },
});

import { arrayToMap } from "@excalidraw/common";
import {
  UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID,
  excludeElementsByHiddenCreators,
  getElementVisibilityBucket,
  getElementsInGroup,
  getSelfCreatorId,
  isCollaboratorInteractive,
  isElementByHiddenCreator,
  isElementInteractive,
} from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ElementsMap, ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import type { AppState } from "../types";

export type LocalVisibilityState = Pick<
  AppState,
  "hiddenCollaboratorIds" | "collaboratorDirectory"
>;

/**
 * Whether the element is hidden on this client by the collaborator
 * visibility controls. Purely a local view filter — scene data is untouched.
 *
 * Creators missing from `collaboratorDirectory` (never seen by this client)
 * share the miscellaneous bucket with untagged elements.
 */
export const isElementHiddenLocally = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  appState: LocalVisibilityState,
): boolean => isElementByHiddenCreator(element, elementsMap, appState);

export type LocalInteractivityState = LocalVisibilityState &
  Partial<Pick<AppState, "lockedCollaboratorIds" | "collaborators">>;

/**
 * Whether this client may interact with the element (#81): not hidden and
 * not locked by the collaborator controls. See `isCollaboratorInteractive`.
 */
export const isElementInteractiveLocally = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
  appState: LocalInteractivityState,
): boolean => isElementInteractive(element, elementsMap, appState);

/**
 * Returns only the elements visible on this client (e.g. for export).
 * Returns the input array as-is when nothing is hidden.
 *
 * @param elementsMap used to resolve bound text containers. Defaults to
 * a map of `elements`, so pass the full scene map when `elements` is a subset.
 */
export const getLocallyVisibleElements = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  appState: LocalVisibilityState,
  elementsMap?: ElementsMap,
): readonly T[] =>
  excludeElementsByHiddenCreators(elements, appState, elementsMap);

/**
 * Selection safety net: hidden or locked (non-interactive) elements must
 * never stay selected, otherwise actions (delete, ungroup, move…) would
 * modify them for every collaborator.
 *
 * Returns the selection-related appState to apply, or `null` if the
 * selection contains no non-interactive elements.
 */
export const getSelectionWithoutHiddenElements = (
  appState: LocalInteractivityState &
    Pick<
      AppState,
      "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "selectedLinearElement"
    >,
  elementsMap: ElementsMap,
): Pick<
  AppState,
  "selectedElementIds" | "selectedGroupIds" | "selectedLinearElement"
> | null => {
  if (
    !appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.size &&
    !appState.lockedCollaboratorIds?.size
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const selfId = getSelfCreatorId(appState);
  // (named `isHidden` since #116; covers locked elements too since #81)
  const isHidden = (id: string) => {
    const element = elementsMap.get(id);
    return (
      !!element && !isElementInteractive(element, elementsMap, appState, selfId)
    );
  };

  const hiddenSelectedIds = Object.keys(appState.selectedElementIds).filter(
    isHidden,
  );
  // a group containing hidden members can't stay selected as a group, or
  // group actions (ungroup, group bbox…) would reach the hidden members
  const groupIdsWithHiddenMembers = Object.keys(
    appState.selectedGroupIds,
  ).filter((groupId) =>
    getElementsInGroup(elementsMap, groupId).some((el) => isHidden(el.id)),
  );
  const isLinearElementHidden =
    !!appState.selectedLinearElement &&
    isHidden(appState.selectedLinearElement.elementId);

  if (
    !hiddenSelectedIds.length &&
    !groupIdsWithHiddenMembers.length &&
    !isLinearElementHidden
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const selectedElementIds = { ...appState.selectedElementIds };
  for (const id of hiddenSelectedIds) {
    delete selectedElementIds[id];
  }

  const selectedGroupIds = { ...appState.selectedGroupIds };
  for (const groupId of groupIdsWithHiddenMembers) {
    delete selectedGroupIds[groupId];
  }

  return {
    selectedElementIds,
    selectedGroupIds,
    selectedLinearElement: isLinearElementHidden
      ? null
      : appState.selectedLinearElement,
  };
};

/** this client's creator id (set by the host app on the current user's entry) */
export const getSelfCollaboratorId = (
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators">,
): string | null => getSelfCreatorId(appState);

/**
 * Whether the user hid their own drawings. Anything they'd draw would be
 * hidden immediately, so the editor is locked to view mode meanwhile.
 */
export const isOwnDrawingsHidden = (
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds">,
): boolean => {
  const selfId = getSelfCollaboratorId(appState);
  return !!selfId && appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(selfId);
};

/**
 * Every visibility bucket currently known on this client: live
 * collaborators, previously seen ones, creators of the scene's elements and
 * the miscellaneous bucket. "Hide all" hides all of these.
 */
export const getVisibilityBuckets = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Pick<AppState, "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory">,
): Set<string> => {
  const buckets = new Set<string>([UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID]);

  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
    if (collaborator.id) {
      buckets.add(collaborator.id);
    }
  }
  for (const clientId of appState.collaboratorDirectory?.keys() ?? []) {
    buckets.add(clientId);
  }

  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (!element.isDeleted) {
      buckets.add(
        getElementVisibilityBucket(
          element,
          elementsMap,
          appState.collaboratorDirectory,
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  return buckets;
};

export type CollaboratorVisibilityRow = {
  /** visibility bucket id (client id, or UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID) */
  id: string;
  username: string | null;
  isCurrentUser: boolean;
  isHidden: boolean;
  /** shown as locked: non-interactive (always true while hidden) */
  isLocked: boolean;
  /** the lock can't be changed: hidden, or your own row */
  isLockDisabled: boolean;
  /** non-deleted elements in this bucket (bound text counts with its shape) */
  drawingsCount: number;
  avatarUrl?: string;
};

export type CollaboratorVisibilityRows = {
  inRoom: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
  previouslySeen: CollaboratorVisibilityRow[];
  miscellaneous: CollaboratorVisibilityRow;
};

/**
 * Whether "Lock all" / "Unlock all" would change anything (#81). Only rows
 * whose lock can change count: hidden collaborators (always locked) and
 * your own row (never locked) are skipped, so after "Hide all" neither
 * button applies.
 */
export const getBulkLockAvailability = ({
  inRoom,
  previouslySeen,
  miscellaneous,
}: CollaboratorVisibilityRows): {
  canLockAll: boolean;
  canUnlockAll: boolean;
} => {
  const changeable = [...inRoom, ...previouslySeen, miscellaneous].filter(
    (row) => !row.isLockDisabled,
  );
  return {
    canLockAll: changeable.some((row) => !row.isLocked),
    canUnlockAll: changeable.some((row) => row.isLocked),
  };
};

/**
 * Rows for the collaborator visibility menu:
 * - in the room: live collaborators (you first)
 * - previously seen: directory entries no longer live (most recent first)
 * - miscellaneous: untagged elements + creators this client never saw
 */
export const getCollaboratorVisibilityRows = (
  elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[],
  appState: Pick<
    AppState,
    "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds"
  > &
    Partial<Pick<AppState, "lockedCollaboratorIds">>,
): CollaboratorVisibilityRows => {
  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);
  const selfId = getSelfCollaboratorId(appState);
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (
      element.isDeleted ||
      // labels count as part of their shape
      (element.type === "text" && element.containerId)
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    const bucket = getElementVisibilityBucket(
      element,
      elementsMap,
      appState.collaboratorDirectory,
    );
    counts.set(bucket, (counts.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  const toRow = (
    id: string,
    username: string | null,
    extra?: Partial<CollaboratorVisibilityRow>,
  ): CollaboratorVisibilityRow => ({
    id,
    username,
    isCurrentUser: false,
    isHidden: appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(id),
    isLocked: !isCollaboratorInteractive(id, appState, selfId),
    isLockDisabled: id === selfId || appState.hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(id),
    drawingsCount: counts.get(id) ?? 0,
    ...extra,
  });

  const inRoom = new Map<string, CollaboratorVisibilityRow>();
  for (const collaborator of appState.collaborators.values()) {
    // several tabs can't share an id, but guard against duplicates anyway
    if (collaborator.id && !inRoom.has(collaborator.id)) {
      inRoom.set(
        collaborator.id,
        toRow(
          collaborator.id,
          collaborator.username ??
            appState.collaboratorDirectory?.get(collaborator.id)?.username ??
            null,
          {
            isCurrentUser: !!collaborator.isCurrentUser,
            avatarUrl: collaborator.avatarUrl,
          },
        ),
      );
    }
  }

  const previouslySeen = [...(appState.collaboratorDirectory ?? [])]
    .filter(([id]) => !inRoom.has(id))
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.lastSeen - a.lastSeen)
    .map(([id, entry]) => toRow(id, entry.username));

  return {
    inRoom: [...inRoom.values()].sort(
      (a, b) =>
        Number(b.isCurrentUser) - Number(a.isCurrentUser) ||
        (a.username ?? "").localeCompare(b.username ?? ""),
    ),
    previouslySeen,
    miscellaneous: toRow(UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID, null),
  };
};
```

```text
import { CREATOR_ID_KEY } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { ExcalidrawElement } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

/**
 * Elements this client introduced to the room that don't carry its creator
 * stamp yet: newly drawn, pasted or duplicated (new id, possibly with a
 * copied foreign stamp), or restored by undo/redo without the stamp.
 *
 * Elements first received from other clients are never (re)stamped, so edits
 * never transfer ownership.
 *
 * @param remoteElementIds ids of elements that first reached this client from
 * the room (other clients or the room's stored scene)
 */
export const getElementsToStamp = <T extends ExcalidrawElement>(
  elements: readonly T[],
  remoteElementIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
  clientId: string,
): T[] =>
  elements.filter(
    (element) =>
      !element.isDeleted &&
      !remoteElementIds.has(element.id) &&
      element.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY] !== clientId,
  );

export const getStampedCustomData = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  clientId: string,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> => ({
  ...element.customData,
  [CREATOR_ID_KEY]: clientId,
});
====
/**
 * Per-room directory of collaborators this browser has seen ("Previously
 * seen"), so their drawings stay attributable — and individually toggleable —
 * after they leave, including across tab close/reopen.
 *
 * Stored locally only (room id → client id → name + last seen). Room keys are
 * never stored, so this can't be used to open a room.
 */

import type { CollaboratorDirectoryEntry } from "@excalidraw/excalidraw/types";

import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../app_constants";

export type CollaboratorDirectory = Map<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry>;

/** keep the most recently used rooms only */
const MAX_ROOMS = 20;
/** keep the most recently seen collaborators per room only */
const MAX_ENTRIES_PER_ROOM = 200;
/**
 * how stale `lastSeen` may get before a sighting is worth recording again
 * (pointer updates arrive ~30×/s, we don't want to write on each)
 */
export const SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS = 60 * 1000;

type StoredRooms = Record<
  string,
  { updated: number; entries: Record<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry> }
>;

const isEntry = (value: any): value is CollaboratorDirectoryEntry =>
  !!value &&
  typeof value === "object" &&
  (value.username === null || typeof value.username === "string") &&
  typeof value.lastSeen === "number";

const readRooms = (): StoredRooms => {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY) ||
        "{}",
    );
    return parsed && typeof parsed === "object" && !Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? parsed
      : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
};

export const loadCollaboratorDirectory = (
  roomId: string,
): CollaboratorDirectory => {
  const directory: CollaboratorDirectory = new Map();
  const entries = readRooms()[roomId]?.entries;
  if (entries && typeof entries === "object") {
    for (const [clientId, entry] of Object.entries(entries)) {
      if (clientId && isEntry(entry)) {
        directory.set(clientId, {
          username: entry.username,
          lastSeen: entry.lastSeen,
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return directory;
};

export const saveCollaboratorDirectory = (
  roomId: string,
  directory: ReadonlyMap<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry>,
) => {
  const { [roomId]: _previous, ...otherRooms } = readRooms();

  const currentRoom = {
    updated: Date.now(),
    entries: Object.fromEntries(
      [...directory]
        .sort(([, a], [, b]) => b.lastSeen - a.lastSeen)
        .slice(0, MAX_ENTRIES_PER_ROOM),
    ),
  };

  // the current room is always kept (even when timestamps tie); the rest
  // are pruned by recency
  const recentOtherRooms = Object.entries(otherRooms)
    .sort(([, a], [, b]) => (b?.updated ?? 0) - (a?.updated ?? 0))
    .slice(0, MAX_ROOMS - 1);

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_COLLABORATOR_DIRECTORY,
      JSON.stringify({
        ...Object.fromEntries(recentOtherRooms),
        [roomId]: currentRoom,
      }),
    );
  } catch {
    // storage unavailable — directory stays in memory for this session
  }
};

/**
 * Records that `clientId` was seen. Returns the updated directory, or `null`
 * when nothing changed enough to be worth publishing/saving.
 *
 * @param username empty/missing = keep the known name (a client may not have
 * picked one yet; that shouldn't erase what we know)
 */
export const recordCollaboratorSighting = (
  directory: ReadonlyMap<string, CollaboratorDirectoryEntry>,
  clientId: string,
  username: string | null | undefined,
  now = Date.now(),
): CollaboratorDirectory | null => {
  const prev = directory.get(clientId);
  const nextUsername = username || prev?.username || null;

  if (
    prev &&
    prev.username === nextUsername &&
    now - prev.lastSeen < SIGHTING_REFRESH_MS
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const next = new Map(directory);
  next.set(clientId, { username: nextUsername, lastSeen: now });
  return next;
};
```

```text
/**
 * Per-tab collaborator identity.
 *
 * Every open tab is its own collaborator (matching the per-tab cursors and
 * avatars), yet a closed tab's id can be reclaimed later so its drawings stay
 * attributed to it:
 *
 * - the browser profile keeps a pool of ids in localStorage
 * - a tab claims an id by holding a Web Lock named after it for its lifetime
 *   (the browser releases it when the tab closes or crashes)
 * - a tab prefers the id in its own sessionStorage (reloads, restored tabs);
 *   a duplicated tab copies sessionStorage but can't get that lock, so it
 *   falls through to a free/new id
 *
 * Without Web Locks we fall back to sessionStorage only (per-tab, but a
 * closed tab's id is not reclaimed).
 */

import { randomId } from "@excalidraw/common";

import { STORAGE_KEYS } from "../app_constants";

/** cap so the pool can't grow unbounded over time */
const MAX_POOL_SIZE = 32;
const POOL_LOCK_NAME = "excalidraw-client-id-pool";
const getIdLockName = (id: string) => `excalidraw-client-id:${id}`;

const readPool = (): string[] => {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS) || "[]",
    );
    return Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? parsed.filter((id): id is string => typeof id === "string" && !!id)
      : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
};

const writePool = (pool: string[]) => {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(
      STORAGE_KEYS.LOCAL_STORAGE_CLIENT_IDS,
      JSON.stringify(pool.slice(-MAX_POOL_SIZE)),
    );
  } catch {
    // storage unavailable (private mode, quota…) — id stays tab-local
  }
};

const readSessionId = (): string | null => {
  try {
    return sessionStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.SESSION_STORAGE_CLIENT_ID);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

const writeSessionId = (id: string) => {
```

# How element ownership, visibility and lock controls work

The system has three layers:

1. **Ownership.** Each element records the client that created it, and that record is synced to everyone.
2. **Bucketing.** Each client sorts elements into "visibility buckets", one per creator.
3. **Per-client controls.** **Hide** and **Lock** are kept only in your own client's `appState`. They are never synced, never saved and never part of undo history.

So hiding or locking someone never changes the shared scene. It only changes what you see and what you can touch.

---

## 1. Ownership: who created an element

**Identity is per browser tab, not per person** (`excalidraw-app/collab/clientIdentity.ts`)

- Every tab gets a stable `clientId` and counts as its own collaborator.
- A browser keeps a pool of ids in localStorage. A tab claims one by holding a Web Lock named after it for as long as the tab is open.
- Reloading a tab keeps its id, because the id is also stored in sessionStorage.
- A duplicated tab can't get the lock on the copied id, so it picks a free id or makes a new one.
- When a tab closes, its id can be reclaimed later, so its old drawings stay attributed to it.
- The id is broadcast over the socket: `USER_IDENTITY`, and in `MOUSE_LOCATION`/idle payloads (`Portal.tsx`). Peers then put it on that collaborator's `Collaborator.id`. Your own entry also gets `isCurrentUser: true` (`Collab.tsx:948-956`).

**Stamping** (`excalidraw-app/collab/creatorStamp.ts`, `Collab.tsx:1040-1075`)

- The creator is stored as `element.customData.creatorId`. The key is `CREATOR_ID_KEY` in `packages/element/src/ownership.ts`.
- `Collab` keeps `remoteElementIds`, the ids of elements that first reached this client from the room (from peers or the stored scene).
- Any other non-deleted element that doesn't carry your stamp gets stamped with your `clientId`. That covers new drawings, pastes, duplicates, and undo restores that lost the stamp. The stamp bumps the element's version, so it syncs.
- **Editing never moves ownership.** Elements that came from the room are never re-stamped, so moving someone else's rectangle leaves it theirs.

**Resolving an element's creator** (`getElementCreatorId`)

- Text bound to a shape uses the shape's creator, so a label always hides and locks together with its shape.
- An element with no valid stamp (for example from an older room) falls into `UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID` (`"__unknown__"`), the **Miscellaneous** bucket.

## 2. Buckets and the collaborator directory

`getElementVisibilityBucket` returns the creator's id, with one twist. If the creator is stamped but **this client has never seen them**, meaning they aren't in `appState.collaboratorDirectory`, the element also goes to Miscellaneous. You can't name someone you've never seen, so they get grouped with the unknowns.

The directory (`excalidraw-app/collab/collaboratorDirectory.ts`):

- It is stored per room in localStorage: client id → `{ username, lastSeen }`.
- It keeps at most 20 rooms and 200 entries per room. Writes are throttled to one per collaborator per 60 seconds.
- It records every collaborator you see in the room, including yourself.
- It powers the **"Previously seen"** section, so people who have left stay attributable and can still be toggled.
- It is set to `null` when you're not in a room. In that case every stamped creator gets their own bucket.

So two users can sort the same element differently. If Alice has seen Carol, she sees Carol's shapes under Carol. If Bob joined after Carol left, those same shapes are under Miscellaneous for him.

## 3. Hide and Lock state

There are two sets in `appState` (`packages/excalidraw/types.ts:574-585`). Both are marked `{ browser: false, export: false, server: false }` in `appState.ts:289-291`, so they are never stored or sent anywhere:

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `hiddenCollaboratorIds` | That bucket is not drawn on screen, and nothing in it can be interacted with. |
| `lockedCollaboratorIds` | That bucket is drawn but can't be interacted with. It behaves like empty canvas. |

**The interactivity rule** (`isCollaboratorInteractive`, `ownership.ts`):

1. **Hidden → never interactive.** You can't interact with what you can't see.
2. **Your own bucket → always interactive.** You can never lock yourself.
3. **Otherwise → interactive unless locked.**

### How the controls change state (`actions/actionCollaboratorVisibility.ts`)

All of these use `CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER`, so they never enter undo history. They also have `viewMode: true`, so they work in view mode.

| Action | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| **Toggle visibility** (eye) | Hiding adds the bucket to the hidden set **and also locks it**. Showing it again removes it from the hidden set only, so it **stays locked** until you unlock it. |
| **Show all** | Clears the hidden set. Locks are untouched, so everyone you had hidden comes back locked. |
| **Hide all** | Hides every known bucket: live collaborators, directory entries, creators of elements in the scene, and Miscellaneous. It also locks all of them except you. |
| **Toggle lock** | Flips one bucket's lock. Does nothing while that bucket is hidden, and does nothing on your own bucket. |
| **Lock all** | Locks every bucket except yours. |
| **Unlock all** | Unlocks every visible bucket. Hidden buckets stay locked, so they are still locked when shown again. |

The menu rows come from `getCollaboratorVisibilityRows` in `scene/visibility.ts`, grouped as **In room** (you first), **Previously seen** (most recent first) and **Miscellaneous**. Each row includes:

- `isLocked`, which is always true while the bucket is hidden.
- `isLockDisabled`, which is true for hidden rows and for your own row.
- A drawing count, where labels count as part of their shape.

`getBulkLockAvailability` greys out **Lock all** or **Unlock all** when pressing it would change nothing. For example, right after **Hide all**, both are disabled.

### Hiding your own drawings

If your own id is in the hidden set (`isOwnDrawingsHidden`), anything you drew would vanish immediately. To prevent that, `App.componentDidUpdate` (`App.tsx:3688`) forces view mode on:

- It saves your previous view-mode setting in `viewModeBeforeSelfHide` and restores it when you show your drawings again.
- `actionToggleViewMode` refuses to leave view mode while your drawings are hidden.
- A banner offers to show your drawings again (`showOwnDrawings`).

## 4. Where the rules are enforced

**Hidden only (not drawn, not targeted):**

- Canvas rendering (`scene/Renderer.ts`).
- Embeds and iframes, and frame name labels. These are DOM elements, so they need their own filter (`App.tsx:1706`, `2077`).
- Frames under the cursor (`App.tsx:7569`).
- Arrow binding and arrow focus. New arrows can't bind to a hidden shape (`binding.ts:622`, `arrows/focus.ts`, `getBindableElements`). A locked shape can still be a binding target, because only the hidden filter applies here.
- Box selection candidates (`App.tsx:11630`).
- Search (`SearchMenu.tsx`).
- Export, which outputs only what you can see (`actionExport.tsx`, `data/index.ts`, and the app's export/share paths in `excalidraw-app/App.tsx`).

**Hidden or locked (non-interactive):**

- Hit testing (`getElementsAtPosition`, `App.tsx:6629`). A locked element counts as empty canvas, so a click lands on whatever is underneath.
- The other hit loops (`App.tsx:6743`, `10529`).
- The eraser (`eraser/index.ts`).
- **Selection checkpoint 1:** `selectGroupsForSelectedElements` (`element/src/groups.ts:192`) drops non-interactive elements, both individually and through their groups.
- **Selection checkpoint 2:** `getSelectionWithoutHiddenElements`, run in `componentDidUpdate` (`App.tsx:3667`). Whenever the selection, the hidden or locked sets, or the directory change, it removes:

  - non-interactive selected elements,
  - any selected group that has such a member,
  - the linear element being edited, if it belongs to one.

  This matters because anything left selected could be deleted, moved or ungrouped **for every collaborator**, since edits to elements are synced even though Hide and Lock are not.

## 5. How this plays out between users

- **Alice hides Bob.** On Alice's screen Bob's shapes disappear. She can't select, erase, export or bind arrows to them. Bob and everyone else see nothing different.
- **Alice locks Bob.** Bob's shapes stay visible to Alice, but her clicks pass through them. Bob can still edit them, and Alice sees his edits live.
- **Bob edits Carol's shape.** It stays Carol's, because ownership doesn't move. If Alice has locked Carol, she can't touch it, but Bob's change still shows up for her.
- **A collaborator leaves.** They move to "Previously seen" and your Hide or Lock on them still applies. If you reload, the directory comes back from localStorage, but the Hide and Lock sets are reset (`Collab.tsx:441`, `541`).
- **Your own row.** You can hide it, which forces view mode, but you can never lock it.

The pure rules are in `packages/element/src/ownership.ts`. The editor-side helpers are in `packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts`. The tests are `ownershipLock.test.ts`, `collaboratorLock.test.tsx` and `collaboratorVisibility.test.tsx`.

---

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-13 00:43:41Z)**_

Most of the editor code wouldn't need to change. Every place that decides whether an element is shown or can be touched already goes through two functions in `packages/element/src/ownership.ts`, so you'd make four changes:

1. Store a list of co-owners on each element.
2. Change the two rule functions so an element counts as visible or interactive if **any** of its owners is.
3. In `Collab`, detect when the local user edits an element someone else created, and stamp them onto it.
4. Update the menu and the "all buckets" helper so they know an element can belong to several buckets.

I haven't made any of these changes; the code below is a plan with sketches.

---

## 1. Data model: keep the creator, add co-owners

Leave `customData.creatorId` as it is (the original creator) and add a list next to it:

```ts
// ownership.ts
export const EDITOR_IDS_KEY = "editorIds";

/** creator + every client that has edited the element, de-duplicated */
const getStampedOwnerIds = (element: ExcalidrawElement): string[] => {
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const creatorId = element.customData?.[CREATOR_ID_KEY];
  if (typeof creatorId === "string" && creatorId) {
    ids.add(creatorId);
  }
  const editorIds = element.customData?.[EDITOR_IDS_KEY];
  if (Array.isArray(editorIds)) {
    for (const id of editorIds) {
      if (typeof id === "string" && id) {
        ids.add(id);
      }
    }
  }
  return [...ids];
};

export const getElementOwnerIds = (element, elementsMap): string[] => {
  const owner = isBoundToContainer(element)
    ? elementsMap.get(element.containerId) ?? element
    : element;
  const ids = getStampedOwnerIds(owner);
  return ids.length ? ids : [UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID];
};
```

Why this shape:

- Keeping `creatorId` means older clients, saved rooms and `creatorStamp.ts` keep working unchanged.
- Bound text still uses its container's owners, so a label can't end up with different rules from its shape.

## 2. The "least restricted owner" rule

Replace the single-bucket lookup with a set of buckets. Owners this client has never seen still map to Miscellaneous:

```ts
export const getElementVisibilityBuckets = (
  element,
  elementsMap,
  collaboratorDirectory,
): Set<string> =>
  new Set(
    getElementOwnerIds(element, elementsMap).map((id) =>
      collaboratorDirectory &&
      id !== UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID &&
      !collaboratorDirectory.has(id)
        ? UNKNOWN_CREATOR_ID
        : id,
    ),
  );

// hidden only if EVERY owner's bucket is hidden
export const isElementByHiddenCreator = (
  element,
  elementsMap,
  { hiddenCollaboratorIds, collaboratorDirectory },
) => {
  if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds?.size) return false;
  for (const bucket of getElementVisibilityBuckets(
    element,
    elementsMap,
    collaboratorDirectory,
  )) {
    if (!hiddenCollaboratorIds.has(bucket)) return false;
  }
  return true;
};

// interactive if ANY owner's bucket is interactive
export const isElementInteractive = (
  element,
  elementsMap,
  state,
  selfId = getSelfCreatorId(state),
) => {
  for (const bucket of getElementVisibilityBuckets(
    element,
    elementsMap,
    state.collaboratorDirectory,
  )) {
    if (isCollaboratorInteractive(bucket, state, selfId)) return true;
  }
  return false;
};
```

`isCollaboratorInteractive` stays the same, so the per-person rules still hold: hidden means locked, and you can never be locked yourself.

Checking your example: the element's owners are {Bob, Carol}. Alice has Bob locked, so his bucket isn't interactive. Carol's is, so the element is interactive for Alice. ✓

Two consequences you should agree to:

- Alice hiding Bob no longer hides that element, because Carol is still visible. That is what "least restricted" means here.
- If you ever edit someone else's element, it becomes yours as well. As long as your own drawings are visible, nobody else's lock can stop you touching it.

Because these two functions are the only checkpoints, the new rule automatically applies to rendering, hit testing, the eraser, both selection checkpoints, search, export and arrow binding. Delete the old singular `getElementVisibilityBucket` instead of keeping it, so the compiler points you at every remaining caller. Today those are only in `scene/visibility.ts`.

## 3. Detecting edits and stamping co-owners (`excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx`)

The hard part is deciding what counts as an edit. I'd use the store's **durable increments** (`excalidrawAPI.onIncrement`):

- They fire only for local changes the user made, including undo and redo. Remote updates are applied with `CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER`, so they never show up here.
- They list exactly which properties of which elements changed (`increment.delta.elements.updated[id].inserted`).
- `store.commit` runs before `props.onChange` (`App.tsx:3898` then `3905`), so whatever the handler records is ready by the time `syncElements` runs for the same change.

```ts
/** properties that change as a side effect, not as a deliberate edit */
const INCIDENTAL_PROPS = new Set([
  "version", "versionNonce", "updated", "index", "boundElements", "customData",
]);

/** elements this client has co-owned; kept, then re-applied (like creator stamps) */
private coOwnedElementIds = new Set<string>();

// on mount, once the API exists; call the returned function on unmount
this.unsubscribeIncrement = this.excalidrawAPI.onIncrement((increment) => {
  if (!StoreIncrement.isDurable(increment) || !this.portal.socketInitialized) return;
  const appState = this.excalidrawAPI.getAppState();
  const map = this.excalidrawAPI.getSceneElementsMapIncludingDeleted();

  for (const [id, delta] of Object.entries(increment.delta.elements.updated)) {
    if (!Object.keys(delta.inserted).some((k) => !INCIDENTAL_PROPS.has(k))) continue;
    const element = map.get(id);
    if (!element || element.isDeleted) continue;
    // editing a label edits its shape
    const target = isBoundToContainer(element)
      ? map.get(element.containerId) ?? element
      : element;
    if (!isDirectlyActedOn(element, target, appState)) continue;
    if (this.remoteElementIds.has(target.id)) {
      this.coOwnedElementIds.add(target.id);
    }
  }
});
```

Then make `syncElements` apply co-owner stamps alongside the creator stamps it already applies, before broadcasting:

```ts
// creatorStamp.ts
export const getElementsToCoOwn = (elements, coOwnedIds, clientId) =>
  elements.filter(
    (el) =>
      !el.isDeleted &&
      coOwnedIds.has(el.id) &&
      !getStampedOwnerIds(el).includes(clientId),
  );

export const getCoOwnedCustomData = (element, clientId) => ({
  ...element.customData,
  [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: [...(element.customData?.[EDITOR_IDS_KEY] ?? []), clientId],
});
```

Two reasons to keep a persistent `coOwnedElementIds` set and re-check it on every sync, instead of stamping once:

- **Undo can remove the stamp.** It reverts `customData` along with everything else. Re-checking re-adds you, the same way creator stamps already survive undo.
- **Concurrent edits can drop it.** Sync is last-writer-wins per element, so if Carol and Dave edit the same element at the same time, one of their `editorIds` lists can lose. Carol's next sync puts her back.

### `isDirectlyActedOn`: the main design decision

Some property changes are side effects you probably shouldn't count as edits:

- Bob drags his rectangle, and Carol's arrow bound to it re-routes. Without a filter, Bob becomes co-owner of Carol's arrow.
- Carol drags her frame, and Bob's shapes inside it move.
- Carol draws an arrow onto Bob's shape, which changes the shape's `boundElements`. `INCIDENTAL_PROPS` already covers this case.

I'd count only elements the user acted on directly: the element (or its container) is in `appState.selectedElementIds`, or it's the text being edited. That covers style changes, moving, resizing, rotating and text edits. Re-routed arrows and frame children are excluded.

If you want moving a frame to claim its contents too, add "is in a selected frame" to the check.

## 4. Menu and bucket helpers (`packages/excalidraw/scene/visibility.ts`)

- **`getVisibilityBuckets`**: add _every_ bucket of each element. Otherwise **Hide all** would miss co-owners and leave their elements showing.
- **`getCollaboratorVisibilityRows`**: count each element once in each of its owner buckets. The per-row counts then add up to more than the total element count, so consider changing the label from "N drawings" to something like "N drawings (incl. shared)".
- **`getSelectionWithoutHiddenElements`** needs no change. It calls `isElementInteractive`, so co-owned elements stay selectable whenever any owner is interactive.

## 5. Tests to add

- **`ownershipLock.test.ts`**:
  - Your example: Bob locked, Carol unlocked, owners {Bob, Carol} → interactive.
  - Both Bob and Carol locked → locked.
  - Bob hidden, Carol visible → visible.
  - Both hidden → hidden.
  - A co-owner who isn't in the directory falls into Miscellaneous.
- **`creatorStamp.test.ts`**:
  - `getElementsToCoOwn` skips elements you already own and deleted elements.
  - It never stamps an id twice.
- **Collab-level**:
  - Carol moving Bob's selected shape adds her to its `editorIds`.
  - Bob dragging a shape that Carol's arrow is bound to does **not** make him an owner of the arrow.
  - Undoing Carol's edit doesn't permanently remove her as an owner.

Run `yarn test:typecheck` and `yarn test:update` before committing, per CLAUDE.md.

---

One thing to settle first: should an edit that's undone keep the editor as a co-owner? The sticky set above says yes. If you'd rather undo also give up ownership, drop the re-apply step and let the change history decide. Once you've picked, and picked a policy for frame contents, I can implement this on the current branch.

```text
packages/excalidraw/history.ts
249 packages/excalidraw/history.ts
import { Emitter } from "@excalidraw/common";

import {
  CaptureUpdateAction,
  StoreChange,
  StoreDelta,
} from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { StoreSnapshot, Store } from "@excalidraw/element";

import type { SceneElementsMap } from "@excalidraw/element/types";

import type { AppState } from "./types";

export class HistoryDelta extends StoreDelta {
  /**
   * Apply the delta to the passed elements and appState, does not modify the snapshot.
   */
  public applyTo(
    elements: SceneElementsMap,
    appState: AppState,
    snapshot: StoreSnapshot,
  ): [SceneElementsMap, AppState, boolean] {
    const [nextElements, elementsContainVisibleChange] = this.elements.applyTo(
      elements,
      // used to fallback into local snapshot in case we couldn't apply the delta
      // due to a missing (force deleted) elements in the scene
      snapshot.elements,
      // we don't want to apply the `version` and `versionNonce` properties for history
      // as we always need to end up with a new version due to collaboration,
      // approaching each undo / redo as a new user action
      {
        excludedProperties: new Set(["version", "versionNonce"]),
      },
    );

    const [nextAppState, appStateContainsVisibleChange] = this.appState.applyTo(
      appState,
      nextElements,
    );

    const appliedVisibleChanges =
      elementsContainVisibleChange || appStateContainsVisibleChange;

    return [nextElements, nextAppState, appliedVisibleChanges];
  }

  /**
   * Overriding once to avoid type casting everywhere.
   */
  public static override calculate(
    prevSnapshot: StoreSnapshot,
    nextSnapshot: StoreSnapshot,
  ) {
    return super.calculate(prevSnapshot, nextSnapshot) as HistoryDelta;
  }

  /**
   * Overriding once to avoid type casting everywhere.
   */
  public static override inverse(delta: StoreDelta): HistoryDelta {
    return super.inverse(delta) as HistoryDelta;
  }

  /**
   * Overriding once to avoid type casting everywhere.
   */
  public static override applyLatestChanges(
    delta: StoreDelta,
    prevElements: SceneElementsMap,
    nextElements: SceneElementsMap,
    modifierOptions?: "deleted" | "inserted",
  ) {
    return super.applyLatestChanges(
      delta,
      prevElements,
      nextElements,
      modifierOptions,
    ) as HistoryDelta;
  }
}

export class HistoryChangedEvent {
  constructor(
    public readonly isUndoStackEmpty: boolean = true,
    public readonly isRedoStackEmpty: boolean = true,
  ) {}
}

export class History {
  public readonly onHistoryChangedEmitter = new Emitter<
    [HistoryChangedEvent]
  >();

  public readonly undoStack: HistoryDelta[] = [];
  public readonly redoStack: HistoryDelta[] = [];

  public get isUndoStackEmpty() {
    return this.undoStack.length === 0;
  }

  public get isRedoStackEmpty() {
    return this.redoStack.length === 0;
  }

  constructor(private readonly store: Store) {}

  public clear() {
    this.undoStack.length = 0;
    this.redoStack.length = 0;
  }

  /**
   * Record a non-empty local durable increment, which will go into the undo stack..
   * Do not re-record history entries, which were already pushed to undo / redo stack, as part of history action.
   */
  public record(delta: StoreDelta) {
    if (delta.isEmpty() || delta instanceof HistoryDelta) {
      return;
    }

    // construct history entry, so once it's emitted, it's not recorded again
    const historyDelta = HistoryDelta.inverse(delta);

    this.undoStack.push(historyDelta);

    if (!historyDelta.elements.isEmpty()) {
      // don't reset redo stack on local appState changes,
      // as a simple click (unselect) could lead to losing all the redo entries
      // only reset on non empty elements changes!
      this.redoStack.length = 0;
    }

    this.onHistoryChangedEmitter.trigger(
      new HistoryChangedEvent(this.isUndoStackEmpty, this.isRedoStackEmpty),
    );
  }

  public undo(elements: SceneElementsMap, appState: AppState) {
    return this.perform(
      elements,
      appState,
      () => History.pop(this.undoStack),
      (entry: HistoryDelta) => History.push(this.redoStack, entry),
    );
  }

  public redo(elements: SceneElementsMap, appState: AppState) {
    return this.perform(
      elements,
      appState,
      () => History.pop(this.redoStack),
      (entry: HistoryDelta) => History.push(this.undoStack, entry),
    );
  }

  private perform(
    elements: SceneElementsMap,
    appState: AppState,
    pop: () => HistoryDelta | null,
    push: (entry: HistoryDelta) => void,
  ): [SceneElementsMap, AppState] | void {
    try {
      let historyDelta = pop();

      if (historyDelta === null) {
        return;
      }

      const action = CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY;

      let prevSnapshot = this.store.snapshot;

      let nextElements = elements;
      let nextAppState = appState;
      let containsVisibleChange = false;

      // iterate through the history entries in case they result in no visible changes
      while (historyDelta) {
        try {
          [nextElements, nextAppState, containsVisibleChange] =
            historyDelta.applyTo(nextElements, nextAppState, prevSnapshot);

          const prevElements = prevSnapshot.elements;
          const nextSnapshot = prevSnapshot.maybeClone(
            action,
            nextElements,
            nextAppState,
          );

          const change = StoreChange.create(prevSnapshot, nextSnapshot);
          const delta = HistoryDelta.applyLatestChanges(
            historyDelta,
            prevElements,
            nextElements,
          );

          if (!delta.isEmpty()) {
            // schedule immediate capture, so that it's emitted for the sync purposes
            this.store.scheduleMicroAction({
              action,
              change,
              delta,
            });

            historyDelta = delta;
          }

          prevSnapshot = nextSnapshot;
        } finally {
          push(historyDelta);
        }

        if (containsVisibleChange) {
          break;
        }

        historyDelta = pop();
      }

      return [nextElements, nextAppState];
    } finally {
      // trigger the history change event before returning completely
      // also trigger it just once, no need doing so on each entry
      this.onHistoryChangedEmitter.trigger(
        new HistoryChangedEvent(this.isUndoStackEmpty, this.isRedoStackEmpty),
      );
    }
  }

  private static pop(stack: HistoryDelta[]): HistoryDelta | null {
    if (!stack.length) {
      return null;
    }

    const entry = stack.pop();

    if (entry !== undefined) {
      return entry;
    }

    return null;
  }

  private static push(stack: HistoryDelta[], entry: HistoryDelta) {
    const inversedEntry = HistoryDelta.inverse(entry);
    return stack.push(inversedEntry);
  }
}
```

```text
  public applyLatestChanges(
    prevElements: SceneElementsMap,
    nextElements: SceneElementsMap,
    modifierOptions?: "deleted" | "inserted",
  ): ElementsDelta {
    const modifier =
      (
        prevElement: OrderedExcalidrawElement | undefined,
        nextElement: OrderedExcalidrawElement | undefined,
      ) =>
      (partial: ElementPartial, partialType: "deleted" | "inserted") => {
        let element: OrderedExcalidrawElement | undefined;

        switch (partialType) {
          case "deleted":
            element = prevElement;
            break;
          case "inserted":
            element = nextElement;
            break;
        }

        // the element wasn't found -> don't update the partial
        if (!element) {
          console.error(
            `Element not found when trying to apply latest changes`,
          );
          return partial;
        }

        const latestPartial: { [key: string]: unknown } = {};

        for (const key of Object.keys(partial) as Array<keyof typeof partial>) {
          // do not update following props:
          // - `boundElements`, as it is a reference value which is postprocessed to contain only deleted/inserted keys
          switch (key) {
            case "boundElements":
              latestPartial[key] = partial[key];
              break;
            default:
              latestPartial[key] = element[key];
          }
        }

        return latestPartial;
      };

    const applyLatestChangesInternal = (
      deltas: Record<string, Delta<ElementPartial>>,
    ) => {
      const modifiedDeltas: Record<string, Delta<ElementPartial>> = {};

      for (const [id, delta] of Object.entries(deltas)) {
        const prevElement = prevElements.get(id);
        const nextElement = nextElements.get(id);

        let latestDelta: Delta<ElementPartial> | null = null;

        if (prevElement || nextElement) {
          latestDelta = Delta.create(
            delta.deleted,
            delta.inserted,
            modifier(prevElement, nextElement),
            modifierOptions,
          );
        } else {
          latestDelta = delta;
        }

        // it might happen that after applying latest changes the delta itself does not contain any changes
        if (Delta.isInnerDifferent(latestDelta.deleted, latestDelta.inserted)) {
          modifiedDeltas[id] = latestDelta;
        }
      }

      return modifiedDeltas;
```

```text
export type CaptureUpdateActionType = ValueOf<typeof CaptureUpdateAction>;

type MicroActionsQueue = (() => void)[];

/**
 * Store which captures the observed changes and emits them as `StoreIncrement` events.
 */
export class Store {
  // for internal use by history
  public readonly onDurableIncrementEmitter = new Emitter<[DurableIncrement]>();
  // for public use as part of onIncrement API
  public readonly onStoreIncrementEmitter = new Emitter<
    [DurableIncrement | EphemeralIncrement]
  >();

  private scheduledMacroActions: Set<CaptureUpdateActionType> = new Set();
  private scheduledMicroActions: MicroActionsQueue = [];

  private _snapshot = StoreSnapshot.empty();

  public get snapshot() {
    return this._snapshot;
  }

  public set snapshot(snapshot: StoreSnapshot) {
    this._snapshot = snapshot;
  }

  constructor(private readonly app: App) {}

  public scheduleAction(action: CaptureUpdateActionType) {
    this.scheduledMacroActions.add(action);
    this.satisfiesScheduledActionsInvariant();
  }

  /**
   * Use to schedule a delta calculation, which will consquentially be emitted as `DurableStoreIncrement` and pushed in the undo stack.
   */
  // TODO: Suspicious that this is called so many places. Seems error-prone.
  public scheduleCapture() {
    this.scheduleAction(CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY);
  }

  /**
   * Schedule special "micro" actions, to-be executed before the next commit, before it executes a scheduled "macro" action.
   */
  public scheduleMicroAction(
    params:
      | {
          action: CaptureUpdateActionType;
          elements: readonly ExcalidrawElement[] | undefined;
          appState: AppState | ObservedAppState | undefined;
        }
      | {
          action: typeof CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY;
          change: StoreChange;
          delta: StoreDelta;
        }
      | {
          action:
            | typeof CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER
            | typeof CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY;
          change: StoreChange;
        },
  ) {
    const { action } = params;

    let change: StoreChange;

    if ("change" in params) {
      change = params.change;
    } else {
      // immediately create an immutable change of the scheduled updates,
      // compared to the current state, so that they won't mutate later on during batching
      // also, we have to compare against the current state,
      // as comparing against the snapshot might include yet uncomitted changes (i.e. async freedraw / text / image, etc.)
      const currentSnapshot = StoreSnapshot.create(
        this.app.scene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted(),
        this.app.state,
      );

      const scheduledSnapshot = currentSnapshot.maybeClone(
        action,
        // let's sync invalid indices first, so that we could detect this change
        // also have the synced elements immutable, so that we don't mutate elements,
        // that are already in the scene, otherwise we wouldn't see any change
        params.elements
          ? syncInvalidIndicesImmutable(params.elements)
          : undefined,
        params.appState,
      );

      change = StoreChange.create(currentSnapshot, scheduledSnapshot);
    }

    const delta = "delta" in params ? params.delta : undefined;

    this.scheduledMicroActions.push(() =>
      this.processAction({
        action,
        change,
        delta,
      }),
    );
  }

  /**
   * Performs the incoming `CaptureUpdateAction` and emits the corresponding `StoreIncrement`.
   * Emits `DurableStoreIncrement` when action is "capture", emits `EphemeralStoreIncrement` otherwise.
   *
   * @emits StoreIncrement
   */
  public commit(
    elements: SceneElementsMap | undefined,
    appState: AppState | ObservedAppState | undefined,
  ): void {
    // execute all scheduled micro actions first
    // similar to microTasks, there can be many
    this.flushMicroActions();

    try {
      // execute a single scheduled "macro" function
      // similar to macro tasks, there can be only one within a single commit (loop)
      const action = this.getScheduledMacroAction();
      this.processAction({ action, elements, appState });
    } finally {
      this.satisfiesScheduledActionsInvariant();
      // defensively reset all scheduled "macro" actions, possibly cleans up other runtime garbage
      this.scheduledMacroActions = new Set();
    }
  }

  /**
   * Clears the store instance.
   */
  public clear(): void {
    this.snapshot = StoreSnapshot.empty();
    this.scheduledMacroActions = new Set();
  }

  /**
   * Performs delta & change calculation and emits a durable increment.
   *
   * @emits StoreIncrement.
   */
  private emitDurableIncrement(
    snapshot: StoreSnapshot,
    change: StoreChange | undefined = undefined,
    delta: StoreDelta | undefined = undefined,
  ) {
    const prevSnapshot = this.snapshot;

    let storeChange: StoreChange;
    let storeDelta: StoreDelta;

    if (change) {
      storeChange = change;
    } else {
      storeChange = StoreChange.create(prevSnapshot, snapshot);
    }

    if (delta) {
      // we might have the delta already (i.e. when applying history entry), thus we don't need to calculate it again
      // using the same instance, since in history we have a check against `HistoryEntry`, so that we don't re-record the same delta again
      storeDelta = delta;
    } else {
      storeDelta = StoreDelta.calculate(prevSnapshot, snapshot);
    }

    if (!storeDelta.isEmpty()) {
      const increment = new DurableIncrement(storeChange, storeDelta);

      this.onDurableIncrementEmitter.trigger(increment);
      this.onStoreIncrementEmitter.trigger(increment);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Performs change calculation and emits an ephemeral increment.
   *
   * @emits EphemeralStoreIncrement
   */
  private emitEphemeralIncrement(
    snapshot: StoreSnapshot,
    change: StoreChange | undefined = undefined,
  ) {
    let storeChange: StoreChange;

    if (change) {
      storeChange = change;
    } else {
      const prevSnapshot = this.snapshot;
      storeChange = StoreChange.create(prevSnapshot, snapshot);
    }

    const increment = new EphemeralIncrement(storeChange);

    // Notify listeners with the increment
    this.onStoreIncrementEmitter.trigger(increment);
  }

  private applyChangeToSnapshot(change: StoreChange) {
    const prevSnapshot = this.snapshot;
    const nextSnapshot = this.snapshot.applyChange(change);

    if (prevSnapshot === nextSnapshot) {
      return null;
    }

    return nextSnapshot;
  }

  /**
   * Clones the snapshot if there are changes detected.
   */
  private maybeCloneSnapshot(
    action: CaptureUpdateActionType,
    elements: SceneElementsMap | undefined,
    appState: AppState | ObservedAppState | undefined,
  ) {
    if (!elements && !appState) {
      return null;
    }

    const prevSnapshot = this.snapshot;
    const nextSnapshot = this.snapshot.maybeClone(action, elements, appState);

    if (prevSnapshot === nextSnapshot) {
      return null;
    }

    return nextSnapshot;
  }

  private flushMicroActions() {
    for (const microAction of this.scheduledMicroActions) {
      try {
        microAction();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(`Failed to execute scheduled micro action`, error);
      }
    }

    this.scheduledMicroActions = [];
  }

  private processAction(
    params:
      | {
          action: CaptureUpdateActionType;
          elements: SceneElementsMap | undefined;
          appState: AppState | ObservedAppState | undefined;
        }
      | {
          action: CaptureUpdateActionType;
          change: StoreChange;
          delta: StoreDelta | undefined;
        },
  ) {
    const { action } = params;

    // perf. optimisation, since "EVENTUALLY" does not update the snapshot,
    // so if nobody is listening for increments, we don't need to even clone the snapshot
    // as it's only needed for `StoreChange` computation inside `EphemeralIncrement`
    if (
      action === CaptureUpdateAction.EVENTUALLY &&
      !this.onStoreIncrementEmitter.subscribers.length
    ) {
      return;
    }

    let nextSnapshot: StoreSnapshot | null;

    if ("change" in params) {
      nextSnapshot = this.applyChangeToSnapshot(params.change);
```

```text
 */
```

```bash
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// co-ownership: editing someone else's element makes you a co-owner
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Element properties whose change doesn't count as editing the element:
 * bookkeeping, z-order, and references updated as a side effect of editing
 * other elements (e.g. binding an arrow updates the shape's `boundElements`).
 */
const NON_EDIT_PROPS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "version",
  "versionNonce",
  "updated",
  "seed",
  "index",
  "boundElements",
  "customData",
]);

const isSameValue = (a: unknown, b: unknown) =>
  a === b ||
  (typeof a === "object" &&
    typeof b === "object" &&
    a !== null &&
    b !== null &&
    JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b));

/** whether going from `prev` to `next` edits the element (see NON_EDIT_PROPS) */
export const isOwnershipEdit = (
  prev: ExcalidrawElement,
  next: ExcalidrawElement,
): boolean => {
  for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(prev), ...Object.keys(next)])) {
    if (
      !NON_EDIT_PROPS.has(key) &&
      !isSameValue(
        prev[key as keyof ExcalidrawElement],
        next[key as keyof ExcalidrawElement],
      )
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CoOwnershipEditState = CreatorSelf & {
  selectedElementIds: Readonly<Record<string, true>>;
  editingTextElement?: { id: string } | null;
  selectedLinearElement?: { elementId: string } | null;
};

/**
 * Whether the user acted on the element directly: it (or the shape a label
 * belongs to) is selected, being text-edited, or its points are being
 * edited. Elements changed as a side effect (an arrow rerouted because the
 * shape it's bound to moved, a frame's children…) aren't.
 */
const isDirectlyEdited = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  holder: ExcalidrawElement,
  state: CoOwnershipEditState,
): boolean =>
  !!state.selectedElementIds[element.id] ||
  !!state.selectedElementIds[holder.id] ||
  state.editingTextElement?.id === element.id ||
  state.selectedLinearElement?.elementId === element.id;

/** whether `clientId` is the element's creator or a co-owner */
export const isElementOwnedBy = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  clientId: string,
): boolean =>
  getStampedCreatorId(element) === clientId ||
  getStampedEditorIds(element).includes(clientId);

/**
 * Elements this client just edited without owning them, so it must become a
 * co-owner (#81 follow-up). Compares the scene against the last committed
 * snapshot, so call it right before a change is captured into history.
 *
 * Returns the elements that hold the ownership (bound text → its container),
 * de-duplicated. Only elements that already existed and have a creator stamp
 * are considered: new elements get the creator stamp, not a co-owner stamp.
 */
export const getElementsToCoOwn = (
  prevElements: ElementsMap,
  nextElements: ElementsMap,
  state: CoOwnershipEditState,
  selfId: string | null = getSelfCreatorId(state),
): ExcalidrawElement[] => {
  if (!selfId) {
    return [];
  }

  const toCoOwn = new Map<string, ExcalidrawElement>();
  for (const next of nextElements.values()) {
    const prev = prevElements.get(next.id);
    if (!prev || prev.version >= next.version || next.isDeleted) {
      continue;
    }
    const holder = getOwnershipHolder(next, nextElements);
    if (
      holder.isDeleted ||
      toCoOwn.has(holder.id) ||
      !getStampedCreatorId(holder) ||
      isElementOwnedBy(holder, selfId) ||
      !isDirectlyEdited(next, holder, state) ||
      !isOwnershipEdit(prev, next)
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    toCoOwn.set(holder.id, holder);
  }
  return [...toCoOwn.values()];
};

/** the element's `customData` with `clientId` added as a co-owner */
export const getCoOwnedCustomData = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  clientId: string,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> => ({
  ...element.customData,
  [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: [...getStampedEditorIds(element), clientId],
});

/**
 * Undo/redo restores an element's whole `customData`, which would also undo
 * co-ownership other clients gained meanwhile. Only this client's own
 * co-ownership may follow history: everybody else's is kept as it was right
 * before the undo/redo.
 *
 * Returns the `customData` to apply instead of `applied`, or `null` when
 * `applied` is already right.
 */
export const reconcileEditorIdsAfterHistory = (
  beforeHistory: ExcalidrawElement,
  applied: ExcalidrawElement,
  selfId: string | null,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> | null => {
  const appliedIds = getStampedEditorIds(applied);
  const isSelfCoOwner = !!selfId && appliedIds.includes(selfId);
  const nextIds = getStampedEditorIds(beforeHistory).filter(
    (id) => id !== selfId,
  );
  if (isSelfCoOwner) {
    nextIds.push(selfId);
  }

  if (
    appliedIds.length === nextIds.length &&
    appliedIds.every((id, i) => id === nextIds[i])
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const { [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: _, ...rest } = applied.customData ?? {};
  return nextIds.length ? { ...rest, [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: nextIds } : rest;
};
```

```bash
cat >> packages/element/src/ownership.ts <<'EOF'

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// co-ownership: editing someone else's element makes you a co-owner
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

/**
 * Element properties whose change doesn't count as editing the element:
 * bookkeeping, z-order, and references updated as a side effect of editing
 * other elements (e.g. binding an arrow updates the shape's `boundElements`).
 */
const NON_EDIT_PROPS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set([
  "version",
  "versionNonce",
  "updated",
  "seed",
  "index",
  "boundElements",
  "customData",
]);

const isSameValue = (a: unknown, b: unknown) =>
  a === b ||
  (typeof a === "object" &&
    typeof b === "object" &&
    a !== null &&
    b !== null &&
    JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b));

/** whether going from `prev` to `next` edits the element (see NON_EDIT_PROPS) */
export const isOwnershipEdit = (
  prev: ExcalidrawElement,
  next: ExcalidrawElement,
): boolean => {
  for (const key of new Set([...Object.keys(prev), ...Object.keys(next)])) {
    if (
      !NON_EDIT_PROPS.has(key) &&
      !isSameValue(
        prev[key as keyof ExcalidrawElement],
        next[key as keyof ExcalidrawElement],
      )
    ) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
};

/** structurally satisfied by the editor's AppState */
export type CoOwnershipEditState = CreatorSelf & {
  selectedElementIds: Readonly<Record<string, true>>;
  editingTextElement?: Readonly<{ id: string }> | null;
  selectedLinearElement?: Readonly<{ elementId: string }> | null;
};

/**
 * Whether the user acted on the element directly: it (or the shape a label
 * belongs to) is selected, being text-edited, or having its points edited.
 * Elements changed as a side effect (an arrow rerouted because the shape it's
 * bound to moved, a dragged frame's children…) don't count.
 */
const isDirectlyEdited = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  holder: ExcalidrawElement,
  state: CoOwnershipEditState,
): boolean =>
  !!state.selectedElementIds[element.id] ||
  !!state.selectedElementIds[holder.id] ||
  state.editingTextElement?.id === element.id ||
  state.selectedLinearElement?.elementId === element.id;

/** whether `clientId` is the element's creator or one of its co-owners */
export const isElementOwnedBy = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  clientId: string,
): boolean =>
  getStampedCreatorId(element) === clientId ||
  getStampedEditorIds(element).includes(clientId);

/**
 * Elements this client edited without owning them, so it becomes a co-owner.
 * Compares the scene against the last committed snapshot, so it's meant to
 * run right before a change is captured into history (the stamp then lands in
 * the same undo entry as the edit, and undoing that edit removes it).
 *
 * Returns the elements holding the ownership (bound text → its container),
 * de-duplicated. Only elements that already existed and carry a creator stamp
 * qualify: new elements get the creator stamp, not a co-owner stamp.
 */
export const getElementsToCoOwn = (
  prevElements: ElementsMap,
  nextElements: ElementsMap,
  state: CoOwnershipEditState,
  selfId: string | null = getSelfCreatorId(state),
): ExcalidrawElement[] => {
  if (!selfId) {
    return [];
  }

  const toCoOwn = new Map<string, ExcalidrawElement>();
  for (const next of nextElements.values()) {
    const prev = prevElements.get(next.id);
    if (!prev || prev.version >= next.version || next.isDeleted) {
      continue;
    }
    const holder = getOwnershipHolder(next, nextElements);
    if (
      holder.isDeleted ||
      toCoOwn.has(holder.id) ||
      !getStampedCreatorId(holder) ||
      isElementOwnedBy(holder, selfId) ||
      !isDirectlyEdited(next, holder, state) ||
      !isOwnershipEdit(prev, next)
    ) {
      continue;
    }
    toCoOwn.set(holder.id, holder);
  }
  return [...toCoOwn.values()];
};

/** the element's `customData` with `clientId` added as a co-owner */
export const getCoOwnedCustomData = (
  element: ExcalidrawElement,
  clientId: string,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> => ({
  ...element.customData,
  [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: [...getStampedEditorIds(element), clientId],
});

/**
 * Undo/redo restores an element's whole `customData`, which would also undo
 * co-ownership that other clients gained in the meantime. Only this client's
 * own co-ownership follows history; everyone else's stays as it was right
 * before the undo/redo.
 *
 * Returns the `customData` to use instead of `applied`'s, or `null` if
 * `applied`'s is already right.
 */
export const reconcileEditorIdsAfterHistory = (
  beforeHistory: ExcalidrawElement,
  applied: ExcalidrawElement,
  selfId: string | null,
): NonNullable<ExcalidrawElement["customData"]> | null => {
  const appliedIds = getStampedEditorIds(applied);
  const nextIds = getStampedEditorIds(beforeHistory).filter(
    (id) => id !== selfId,
  );
  if (selfId && appliedIds.includes(selfId)) {
    nextIds.push(selfId);
  }

  if (
    appliedIds.length === nextIds.length &&
    appliedIds.every((id, i) => id === nextIds[i])
  ) {
    return null;
  }

  const { [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: _editorIds, ...rest } = applied.customData ?? {};
  return nextIds.length ? { ...rest, [EDITOR_IDS_KEY]: nextIds } : rest;
};
EOF
```

```text
    "collaborators" | "collaboratorDirectory" | "hiddenCollaboratorIds"
  > &
    Partial<Pick<AppState, "lockedCollaboratorIds">>,
): CollaboratorVisibilityRows => {
  const elementsMap = arrayToMap(elements);

  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const element of elements) {
    if (
      element.isDeleted ||

    const bucket = getElementVisibilityBucket(
      element,
      elementsMap,
      appState.collaboratorDirectory,
    );
    counts.set(bucket, (counts.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
```
